notes.title: Caught On Camera – New and Final Update Available!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I'm excited to share a new update for Caught On Camera! This version brings some important improvements and fixes to make the experience smoother and more immersive.

 What’s New:

Switched to Unity's HDRP pipeline
The game now runs on the High Definition Render Pipeline, allowing for better lighting, shadows, and overall visual quality.

Updated the factory scene
The factory scene has been redesigned to offer a better visual experience and atmosphere.

Fixed several typos and spelling mistakes
Thanks to everyone who pointed them out!

Thank you so much for playing, supporting, and sharing feedback.
Stay sharp... and watch those cameras.

nabetsonga
